CHAPTER.VERS: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to , all you lands!
Serve with gladness.Come before his presence with singing.
Know that , he is God.It is he who has made us, and we are his.We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,into his courts with praise.Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
For is good.His loving kindness endures forever,his faithfulness to all generations.
